The Buot\u2013Samboryo\u2013Babag Ridge\u2013Guila Trail is a roughly 7.58 km point-to-point hike in the Buot-Taup area of Cebu City, with paved-road access at both ends. I followed a shorter reverse variation of my earlier Buot\u2013Guila-Guila\u2013Cabatbatan\u2013Samboryo Trail Loop<\/a>, including about 2.72 km of previously unvisited trail that I refer to here as the Phase 1 Babag Ridge Trail<\/em>. <\/p>\n\n\n\n

Much of the ridge was open and covered in cogon grass, while several sections closer to the communities passed under better tree cover. I did this hike in September 2026. <\/p>\n\n\n
